cache_control.description: Create a cache control breakpoint at this content block.
cache_control.title: Cache Control

caching.description: Caching for the advisor's own prompt. When set, each advisor call writes a cache entry at the given TTL so subsequent calls in the same conversation read the stable prefix. When omitted, the advisor prompt is not cached.
caching.title: Caching

defer_loading.description: If true, tool will not be included in initial system prompt. Only loaded when returned via tool_reference from tool search.
defer_loading.title: Defer Loading

max_tokens.description: Bounds the advisor's total output (thinking + text) per call. When the advisor hits this cap, the returned advisor_result or advisor_redacted_result block carries stop_reason='max_tokens', and a truncation note is appended to the advice text the worker model sees (inside the encrypted blob in redacted mode). When set, the API also passes the advisor its remaining-token budget, so the advisor shapes its output toward the cap. When omitted, the advisor model's default output cap applies and the API doesn't pass a budget.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

max_uses.description: Maximum number of times the tool can be used in the API request.
max_uses.title: Max Uses

name.description:
Name of the tool.

This is how the tool will be called by the model and in `tool_use` blocks.
name.title: Name

strict.description: When true, guarantees schema validation on tool names and inputs
strict.title: Strict
